# Research Data-Collection Consent & Provenance Template

> **This is a plain-language RESEARCH template, not a legal document.** It has
> **not** been reviewed by a lawyer or an ethics board. Before collecting data
> from real businesses at any scale, the project team must obtain appropriate
> **institutional and/or legal review** for the jurisdiction(s) involved. Do
> **not** describe the project as "GDPR compliant", "DPDP Act compliant" or
> "legally compliant" unless that has actually been established in writing.

Fill one copy per participating business (keep it with the project's records,
**not** in the DecisionGPT database).

---

## 1. Participation is voluntary

The business named below chooses to share a small amount of **anonymised,
aggregate** information about one or more business decisions and their outcomes.
Participation is entirely optional and can be withdrawn at any time, with no
consequence.

## 2. Purpose

The data is used only to **evaluate how close DecisionGPT's predictions are to
real business outcomes** — a research/evaluation purpose. It is not used for
marketing, credit assessment, or any commercial decision about the business.

## 3. What is collected

Per decision, aggregate figures only:
- business type, state/region (coarse), a **self-chosen anonymous code**;
- decision date, decision type, goal, recommended strategy, prediction horizon;
- revenue before / predicted / actual (and, if available, profit and
  units/orders);
- the predicted risk and confidence numbers DecisionGPT displayed;
- the date the actual result was recorded and an outcome status.

## 4. What is NOT collected

No Aadhaar / PAN / GSTIN, no phone numbers, no personal email, no customer
names or contacts, no bank/card numbers, no addresses that identify a person,
no raw transaction data. The import tool automatically **rejects** any record
that appears to contain these.

## 5. Anonymisation

Only the self-chosen code (e.g. `SME-A1`) is stored. The stored business record
is *"Anonymised Indian SME [SME-A1]"* plus the numbers above. Nothing links the
code to the business name or owner inside the DecisionGPT system.

## 6. Retention & use

- The anonymised records are retained for the duration of the research
  evaluation and any resulting publication.
- Results are reported **in aggregate only**. Individual businesses are never
  named or singled out.
- The data is kept separate from all synthetic test data and public datasets.

## 7. Permission for aggregated research use

The business permits the use of its **anonymised, aggregated** contribution in
research write-ups and a possible academic paper, understanding that no
individual business will be identifiable.

## 8. Right to decline / withdraw

The business may decline to answer any item, decline to participate, or ask for
a previously shared record to be deleted, at any time, by contacting the
project team.
